pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit irregular polygonal geometry with predominantly smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is heterogeneous, with larger areas on the upper flank and neck compared to smaller, more fragmented shapes on the lower visible sections.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored inter-patch network is continuous with relatively uniform pixel thickness. Junction nodes are clearly visible as tri-nodal intersections forming a stable topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serration profile. The silhouette against the background is composed of short, dark, dense hair-tips.
